captions.span: Ek important baat pehle samajh lein.
captions.text: First, let's understand one important thing.

captions.span: Zetwerk ko chhodkar baaki 3 IPOs pure OFS hain.
captions.text: Except Zetwerk, the other 3 IPOs are pure OFS.

captions.span: OFS yaani Offer for Sale,
captions.text: OFS means Offer for Sale,

captions.span: jismein company naye shares jaari nahi karti,
captions.text: where the company does not issue new shares,

captions.span: balki existing shareholders apne shares bechte hain.
captions.text: instead existing shareholders sell their shares.

captions.span: Isliye us paise mein se company ko kuch nahi milta,
captions.text: So the company gets nothing from that money,

captions.span: woh seedha bechne wale shareholders ko jaata hai.
captions.text: it goes straight to the selling shareholders.

captions.span: Zetwerk mein fresh issue bhi hai aur OFS bhi.
captions.text: Zetwerk has both a fresh issue and an OFS.
